notes.title: Download the Asurya's Embers Art Book for Free!
notes.content:
Download the Art of Asurya's Embers today!

Embark on a captivating journey to the majestic Himalayas as you delve into the enchanting world of Asurya's Embers through the pages of our exquisite (and free!) digital Art Book. 

The genesis of the artwork for Asurya's Embers dates back to the summer of 2023, when prototypes were carefully crafted, laying the foundation for the intricate landscapes and captivating characters that would come to life in the final production. With dedicated execution and implementation in the subsequent fall, our team brought forth a world of depth and allure. 

Prepare to be transported to a realm of excitement, adventure, and haunting beauty. We invite you to savor this exploration of Asurya's Embers—a testament to the creativity and artistic talents of our team.

You can download the book directly here: https://joom.ag/lkZd

notes.title: Asurya's Embers Soundtrack Releases Next Week!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44864470/8ff80178adbca65817560ed08d01165c19f26122.png[/img]

This upcoming Wednesday, March 20th, the beautiful, live-recorded soundtrack to Asurya's Embers will release on Steam! You can download this soundtrack by going to our game's store page, searching for it directly in the Steam search bar, or by clicking the link below. 

The soundtrack for Asurya's Embers was composed and performed by student musicians at SMU's Meadows School of the Arts. Theodore Morris was the lead composer, with additional music compositions by Nha-Y Duong, Matthew Foss, and Anika Saiprabhu. The solo sarangi performance was by Deepak Paramashivan and the solo soprano performance was by Jasmine Williams. 

The remaining instrumental performers were Duncan McVety (Violin), Brandon Morrison (Violin), Matt Velasquez (Violin), Spencer Byrd (Viola), Nha-Y Duong (Viola), Jackson Benjamin (Cello), Katelyn Petersen (Cello), Israel MacDonald (Double Bass), Kristen Edwards (Flute), Kendra Hamblin (Flute), Jackson Thomas War (French Horn), Melody Tang (Percussion), and Max Wittaker (Percussion).

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2851320/Asuryas_Embers_Soundtrack/

notes.title: Capture Cinematic Screenshots in Asurya's Embers
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44864470/e7f588b6fecacf174461c84023b1c5e137a9b832.jpg[/img]

Our entire development team is excited to see players enjoying our game and we wanted to let you all know about a new way to have fun with [i]Asurya's Embers[/i]—with screenshots! Enjoy flying around and seeing our world and enemies from afar or up close with this feature. We hope this makes the world of [i]Asurya's Embers[/i] even more enjoyable to explore!

📸 [b]How to Unleash Your Creative Side:[/b]
[olist]
[*] [b]Set the Stage:[/b] In-game, position your character and scene for the perfect shot
[*] [b]Initiate the Magic:[/b] When you're ready, press [b]F10[/b] to pause gameplay and enter free-camera mode
[*] [b]The Art of Control:[/b] Utilize the [b]WASD[/b] keys for standard movement, [b]E/Q[/b] to elevate or descend, and the mouse to pivot your view
[*] [b]Capture the Moment:[/b] Press [b]F12[/b] to immortalize your masterpiece directly from Steam, or employ your preferred screenshot method to capture the magic
[/olist]
Take some screenshots yourself and share them with us! We'd love to see how creative you can be with our feature.

notes.title: Celebrating World Pangolin Day with Asurya's Embers!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44864470/577f1e45aa1fed375a374e2ce5cf181e0f2c98ac.jpg[/img]
Happy (belated) World Pangolin Day from the [i]Asurya's Embers[/i] team!

Our studio acknowledges that while one of game enemies is represented by a mutated colossal pangolin, we disavow any endorsement or encouragement of violence directed toward these remarkable creatures.

Approximately 200,000 pangolins annually fall victim to poaching activities, thereby significantly endangering their existence within their indigenous habitats spanning Africa and Asia. Pangolins are identified as one of the most heavily trafficked mammals globally.

As a unified team, we have, in a symbolic gesture, undertaken the adoption of a Pangolin through a contribution to the World Wildlife Fund. Our goal is for wildlife preservation initiatives to persist and prosper.

We hope this inspires developers and players worldwide to use their resources to ongoing conservation efforts. Looking forward to our mutated enemies landing in your Steam libraries on March 6th, and the wellbeing of our [i]non[/i]-mutated pangolin friends far into the future!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44864470/cd7d97477e7146941bd4030debfd7a8e8dba4771.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Happy Chinese New Year from the Asurya's Embers Team!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44864470/d403ac797366b6217f8d7ae1112f185d52a5ef86.png[/img]

Happy Lunar New Year from all of us from the [i]Asurya's Embers[/i] team!

With our community page now live, allow us a moment to introduce ourselves. We are a group of 24, multinational student-developers at SMU Guildhall. We made [i]Asurya's[/i] over the course of an 18-week period, exclusively working during core development hours (Monday-Friday, 10:00 - 1:00 PM). 

As a studio, we were dedicated to creating a polished game, that previews AAA-level quality within the constraints of development. We wanted to not only make innovative systems - we aimed to create an immersive experience. Ours was a team that embraced innovation, actively seeking opportunities to explore new ideas and acquire fresh skills. 

It was important to us that we incorporate and acknowledge our multicultural, international background. We set our game in the Himalayas as an homage to our team members from South Asia and China, transforming a famous legend into novel, inspiring game-play. 

Above all, [i]Asurya's Embers[/i] was made in a collaborative environment of mutual care and respect. We cannot wait to share our game with you when it releases on March 6th! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44864470/6d493d0945496512a3f361570920408f354d34ca.jpg[/img]
